how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-hinterlands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7850:obj:0: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of ⟦E1⟧ from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.
rows.quest:7850:details:0: The Vilebranch fight with supernatural ferocity. This is due to the foul magical weavings of the Vile Priestess Hexx.
rows.quest:7850:details:1: BThroughout Jintha'alor you will find dark vessels of tainted blood. The vessels radiate the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and also driving them to madness.
rows.quest:7850:details:2: BSteal those vessels and return them to me so that I may remove the taint and ultimately loosen the grip of the blood God.
rows.quest:7850:completion:0: The dark energy that compels the Vilebranch has been lifted - for now. We must remain ever vigilant in our battle against evil, as even if the Vile Priestess is destroyed, another soon takes her place.
rows.quest:7861:obj:0: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
rows.quest:7861:obj:1: BVile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7861:details:0: By order of Primal Torntusk, Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions are to be brought to justice!
rows.quest:7861:details:1: BA grand reward is offered for any that slay the Vile Priestess Hexx and all of her Aman'zasi elite guard.
rows.quest:7861:completion:0: A crippling blow to the Vilebranch, indeed. You shall be richly rewarded, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:7862:obj:0: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
rows.quest:7862:obj:1: BShould you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
rows.quest:7862:details:0: With the loss of Guard Captain Malkhor, the position of Guard Captain of Revantusk is once again open. If you are interested in becoming Captain of the Guard for Revantusk, complete the following tasks and submit your application to Primal Torntusk:
rows.quest:7862:completion:0: You are indeed a worthy candidate for the new position, ⟦2⟧. Accept this trinket as a token of our appreciation for your hard work. I will be reviewing all applications next year.
rows.quest:8273:completion:0: Now isn't this interesting? You say you found this tablet on a small, deserted island at The Overlook Cliffs in ⟦E2⟧, ⟦3⟧? Very interesting indeed. <Oran carefully puts the tablet away and rubs her hands together.>
rows.quest:8273:completion:1: BI thank you for your efforts in this matter. Our Dark Lady shall be very pleased with this discovery. Here, allow me to reward you proportionately.
